senses.gloss:
अच्युत, minister to Śivasiṃha, king of Mithilā, father of
Ratnapāṇi (Kāvyadarpaṇa), father of Ravi (Kāvya-
prakāśaṭīkā). Peters. 3, 333.
अच्युत poet. Śp. p. 5.
Kṛṣṇaśataka. Paris (D 249).

Guruvaraprārthanāpañcaratnastotra. Bṛhatstotra-
ratnākara p. 299.
Bhāgīrathīcampū. Kāvyamālā.

Ratnamālā (jy). Sūcīpattra 18.
[]

अच्युत, son of Dharaṇigoṇiga, son of Mahādeva, son of
Soma, son of Hari:
 Rasasaṃgrahasiddhānta (med.). W. p. 299.

अच्युत the author of the Bhāgīrathīcampū, was a son
of Nārāyaṇa, and wrote it in 1815. It is divided
into 7 chapters, called manoratha.
Advaitamañjarī.

अच्युत of Pañcavatī, son of Nārāyaṇa, wrote in 1815:
 Bhāgīrathīcampū.
Keralajyautiṣa.

Bhāvārthamañjarī, a C. on Śrīpati's Jātaka-
paddhati.

अच्युत ठक्कुर maternal grandfather of Raghudeva (Viru-
dāvalī). Oxf. 133^a.

अच्युत शर्मन्
 Dāyabhāgaṭīkā. IO. 76 A.

अच्युत शर्मन्
 Vedāntāmṛtacidratnacaṣakaṭīkā. B. 4, 96.

अच्युत भट्ट
 Bhāsvatīkaraṇaṭīkā. IO. 234.

अच्युत भट्ट son of Sāgara:
 Bhāsvatīkaraṇaṭīkā Bhāsvatīratnamālā. Acyuta,
the author of the Ratnamālā, Sūcīpust. 18,
is probably identical with the preceding.

अच्युत सूरि
 C. on Mādhava's Śaṅkaravijaya. B. 2, 134.

अच्युत यति disciple of Madhusūdanāśrama:
 Sītārāmāṣṭaka stotra. Bṛhatstotraratnākara
p. 276.

अच्युत चक्रवर्तिन् son of Haridāsa Tarkācārya:
 Hāralatāṭīkā. IO. 244. NW. 100.

अच्युत चक्रवर्तिन् son of Haridāsa Tarkācārya:
 Hāralatāṭīkā Saṃdarbhasūtikā.

Ekādaśīmāhātmya. Rice 82.
 Chāndogyopaniṣadvivaraṇa. Rice 52.

अच्युतकृष्णानन्दतीर्थ disciple of Svayamprakāśānandatirtha
Sarasvatī:
 Kṛṣṇālaṃkāra Śāstrasiddhāntaleśasaṃgrahaṭīkā.
Taittirīyopaniṣadbhāṣyavyākhyā Vanamālā.
अच्युतचरित by Gaṅgādāsa. Mentioned Oxf. 198^b.
अच्युतपारम्यस्तोत्र by Vīrarāghava. Oudh 1877, 56.
अच्युतप्रेक्षाचार्य guru of Ānandatīrtha. Bhr. p. 202.

अच्युतरघुनाथ भूपाल
 Rāmāyaṇasārasaṃgraha.

अच्युतरामाभ्युदय kāvya by Rājanātha. Burnell 156^b.
Oppert 1375. 1734. II, 2710.

अच्युतशतक stotra. Taylor 1, 146. Oppert 1089. 2500.
5475. II, 3559. Rice 268.

अच्युताश्रम, disciple of Pāramānandāśrama or Cidā-
nandāśrama:
 Rāmanāmamāhātmya.
 Rāmārcanacandrikā.
 Viśveśarīpaddhati (dh.).
 Saṃnyāsadharmasaṃgraha.
अच्युताश्रम add Svaprakāśapradīpikā.

अच्युताष्टक stotra by Śaṅkarācārya. Pet. 726. Poona
593. Printed in Bṛhatstotraratnākara p. 101. 135
(two different versions).

अच्युताष्टक by Śaṅkarācārya. AK 107. AS p. 2.
Peters. 6, 262.
Gauragadādharāṣṭaka or Utkaṇṭhamaṇimālikā.
Taittirīyakabhāṣya Vanamālā.
